title: kit.toolchain.v1
description: packages/core/registry/toolchain.json: the ONE pin of the toolchain every machine that runs the kit uses (node, npm, git, docker), exact versions. `kit check staleness` compares each tool with its `--version` where the tool is required (`required_on`: a GitHub runner `ci`, a `codespace`, or any other `machine`; where each is decided by the environment variables of `host`); any other version is toolchain-drift. The workflows' node-version, the templates and the codespace definition are checked against it (or generated from it), never a second copy.

host.description: The environment variables that say where a run is: `ci_env` is "true" on a GitHub runner, `codespace_env` is "true" in a codespace; neither is a laptop or a bare host (`machine`).

exact.description: The exact version every machine where the tool is required runs.
